description: Channel-local hybrid of article_geometry_v6 and typed_receipt_v1: keep free-inverse geometry, typed XML fields, wordcode dictionaries, and LZMA container, but optionally encode the dominant AO-packed scaffold channel with the receipt graph coder. Complete archive selection falls back to plain article_geometry_v6.
codec: article geometry typed channels with optional receipt-coded scaffold
notes: Targets the measured weak channel: at 10MB article_geometry_v6's scaffold channel dominates compressed size. All embedded engines are counted in this directory.
